shared_elements: lines cut into a weathered stone surface
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both are stone surfaces bearing cut linear marks, with some arcing grooves in each, and A's angular scratches bear no relation to B's ordered, bilaterally symmetrical stack of rings, arcs and banded motifs on a shaped monolith. A is a flat, rough, lichened rock face with faint, irregular incisions of uncertain subject; B is a freestanding sculpted figure in dark stone carved in low relief with deliberate, repeated geometric devices — different formats, techniques and compositional logic entirely.
